lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, exhibiting a grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes within a grid-like pattern on the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadow transition immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent semi-circular notch or excision is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a high-density clustering of small, lower-contrast spots compared to the larger, more structured blobs on the flank.
